summary: 11 film announcements, 9 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Final Girl Support Group
film.announcement: Paramount acquired the feature film rights with Christopher Landon set to direct and adapt. Aperture Entertainment and the Muschietti brothers' Double Dream are producing.

film.title: Children of Blood and Bone
film.announcement: Film adaptation in development with director Gina Prince-Bythewood attached, though author Tomi Adeyemi recently expressed serious dissatisfaction with the project.

film.title: Live 2 Die
film.talent: Josh Bowman, Ron Perlman, Esai Morales
film.announcement: Josh Bowman, Ron Perlman, and Esai Morales cast in the film.

film.title: Tormented Souls
film.studio: ZQ Entertainment, Prime Universe, Longevity Pictures
film.announcement: ZQ Entertainment, Prime Universe, and Longevity Pictures acquired film and TV rights to the horror video game for adaptation.

film.title: Thud
film.announcement: Grim reaper-devil romance film starring Sarah Michelle Gellar and Rudy Pankow adds seven cast members including Steve Agee and Karan Soni.

film.title: Richard Pryor [Untitled]
film.announcement: Biographical film based on Richard Pryor's daughter Elizabeth Stordeur Pryor's memoir 'Something We Said' in development from Latigo Films and Inaugural Entertainment.

film.title: Show of Hands
film.announcement: Frank Grillo to lead political kidnapping comedy from director P.J. Pesce.

film.title: American Summer
film.announcement: Family comedy starring Steve Guttenberg and Christie Brinkley lands theatrical release.

film.title: Two Untitled Scripts
film.talent: Taylor Sheridan (picking up scripts), Andrew Lauren (producer of 'Brutalist')
film.announcement: Taylor Sheridan and 101 Studios picked up two movie scripts from 'Brutalist' producer Andrew Lauren.

film.title: The Conjuring: First Communion
film.talent: Charles Parnell, Marta Kessler, Caleb Dolden
film.announcement: The Conjuring film rounds out its cast with Charles Parnell, Marta Kessler, and Caleb Dolden.

film.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
film.announcement: Remake of 'The Thomas Crown Affair' with Michael B. Jordan directing and starring as a thief; teaser released.

tv.title: Task
tv.announcement: Martha Plimpton and Silvia Dionicio confirmed to return for Season 2 of HBO's 'Task'.

tv.title: Possession
tv.talent: Madeline Brewer, Emory Cohen, Nicholas Alexander Chavez
tv.announcement: Madeline Brewer, Emory Cohen, and Nicholas Alexander Chavez join Paramount's 'Possession'.

tv.title: Chad Powers
tv.announcement: Season 2 of Glen Powell's comedy series sets fall release date with first look photos released.

tv.title: Reacher
tv.talent: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, Ciara Bravo
tv.announcement: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, and Ciara Bravo join Alan Ritchson for Season 5.

tv.title: Young Sherlock
tv.talent: Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, Aidan Gillen
tv.announcement: Season 2 adds Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, and Aidan Gillen to cast with returning cast members confirmed.

tv.title: Robin Hood
tv.announcement: Graeme Thomas King upped to series regular for Season 2 as Prince John.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: AMC's NASCAR series 'Thunder Road' casts 'Silo' star Shane McRae.

tv.title: American Idol
tv.announcement: American Idol renewed for Season 10 on ABC, marking the show's 25th season overall.

tv.title: Best in Class
tv.announcement: Comcast's Xfinity launches creator reality series 'Best in Class' hosted by Katie Feeney.
